meaning:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Gen.30:42 (קָשַׁר), Est.5:4 8:13, 1Ma.11:37 1Mac 14:48, 2Ma.15:36, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
1. bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined.
2. Metaphorical,
(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Rom.16:7;
(b) in bad sense, notorious: Mat.27:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
